# uptimekuma_monitor_kafka_producer (Resource)

Kafka Producer monitor resource for testing connectivity to Apache Kafka clusters and verifying message publishing capabilities.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Kafka Producer Monitor Resource Example

# Basic Kafka Producer monitor with minimum required configuration
resource "uptimekuma_monitor_kafka_producer" "basic" {
  name    = "Kafka Producer Monitor"
  brokers = ["kafka.example.com:9092"]
  topic   = "uptime-monitor"
  message = "ping"
}

# Kafka Producer monitor connecting to a multi-broker cluster
resource "uptimekuma_monitor_kafka_producer" "cluster" {
  name = "Kafka Cluster Monitor"
  brokers = [
    "kafka-1.example.com:9092",
    "kafka-2.example.com:9092",
    "kafka-3.example.com:9092",
  ]
  topic                     = "uptime-monitor"
  message                   = "ping"
  ssl                       = true
  allow_auto_topic_creation = false
  timeout                   = 5
  interval                  = 120
  retry_interval            = 60
  max_retries               = 3
}

# Kafka Producer monitor with SASL authentication
resource "uptimekuma_monitor_kafka_producer" "sasl" {
  name    = "Kafka Producer SASL"
  brokers = ["kafka.example.com:9093"]
  topic   = "uptime-monitor"
  message = "ping"
  ssl     = true
  timeout = 2.5

  sasl_options = jsonencode({
    mechanism = "scram-sha-512"
    username  = "monitor-user"
    password  = "monitor-password"
  })

  notification_ids = [1, 2]

  tags = [
    {
      tag_id = 1
      value  = "production"
    }
  ]
}

# Requires Terraform or OpenTofu 1.11 or later: sasl_options_wo is never stored in
# plan or state. Change sasl_options_wo_version whenever the secret changes.
resource "uptimekuma_monitor_kafka_producer" "write_only" {
  name = "Kafka producer monitor with write-only SASL options"

  brokers = ["kafka.example.com:9092"]
  topic   = "monitor-topic"
  message = "ping"

  sasl_options_wo         = jsonencode({ mechanism = "plain", username = "monitor", password = "kafka-password" })
  sasl_options_wo_version = "1"
}
```

## Schema

### Required

- `brokers` (List of String) List of Kafka broker addresses (e.g. `host:port`).
- `message` (String) Test message to publish to the Kafka topic.
- `name` (String) Friendly name
- `topic` (String) Kafka topic to publish the test message to.

### Optional

> **NOTE**: [Write-only arguments](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments) are supported in Terraform 1.11 and later.

- `active` (Boolean) Monitor is active
- `allow_auto_topic_creation` (Boolean) Whether to allow automatic topic creation on the Kafka broker.
- `description` (String) Description
- `interval` (Number) Heartbeat interval in seconds. Minimum 20. Uptime Kuma 2.5.0 removed the former 24 day maximum, so no upper bound is enforced.
- `max_retries` (Number) Maximum number of retries
- `notification_ids` (List of Number) List of notification IDs
- `parent` (Number) Parent monitor ID for hierarchical organization
- `resend_interval` (Number) Resend interval in seconds
- `retry_interval` (Number) Retry interval in seconds. Minimum 20, and like `interval` it has no upper bound since Uptime Kuma 2.5.0.
- `sasl_options` (String, Sensitive) SASL authentication options as a JSON-encoded object (e.g. `{"mechanism":"plain","username":"u","password":"p"}`). Stored in state; use `sasl_options_wo` to keep it out of state.
- `sasl_options_wo` (String, Sensitive, [Write-only](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments)) SASL authentication options as a JSON-encoded object, write-only: sent to Uptime Kuma on create and update but never stored in plan or state. Requires Terraform 1.11 or OpenTofu 1.11 or later. Conflicts with `sasl_options`; requires `sasl_options_wo_version`. An imported resource has no `sasl_options_wo_version` yet, so `terraform import` may store the server's value in `sasl_options` until the next apply with `sasl_options_wo` set removes it from state.
- `sasl_options_wo_version` (String) Any value that changes whenever `sasl_options_wo` changes, for example a counter or a hash of the secret's encrypted source. A change triggers an update that sends the current `sasl_options_wo`.
- `ssl` (Boolean) Whether to enable SSL/TLS for the Kafka connection.
- `tags` (Attributes Set) Set of tags assigned to this monitor (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--tags))
- `timeout` (Number) Connection timeout in seconds, handed to kafkajs as its `connectionTimeout`. Must be at least 0.1; fractional values are supported and round-trip unchanged. Defaults to 1, the value the Uptime Kuma web UI assigns to a new Kafka Producer monitor. The floor exists because Uptime Kuma treats 0 or less as no timeout being set and substitutes a value derived from `interval` instead of using it as a timeout. The server enforces no upper bound, but saving the monitor in the web UI clamps the value to 80% of `interval`, so a monitor edited there afterwards can come back lowered. A monitor created outside Terraform may have 0 stored, which reads into state as 0 and plans back to the default on the next apply; 0 itself cannot be written in configuration.
- `upside_down` (Boolean) Invert monitor status (treat DOWN as UP and vice versa)

### Read-Only

- `id` (Number) Monitor identifier
